The Commandant puts on the power armor and arrives at the outdoor platform, where Rosetta is already locked in combat with the fake Mina.

The Commandant rushes forward and sees Rosetta fighting Mina. Upon noticing the Commandant, the fake Mina reveals his true identity: Zack the Frostheart Emperor, last emperor of the old Sophiasburgh. From his time observing Babylonia, he believes the world remains divided, and now he intends to lead the spirits of the past to unify it.
Talk with Rosetta about the current situation
After watching the fallen fake Mina vanish, the Commandant and Rosetta discuss the situation on the platform.
The Commandant removes the power armor and returns to the Military Security Area by elevator.
